components.css: .ds-card{width:320px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e2ddd4;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,19,15,.05),0 12px 28px -18px rgba(20,19,15,.35);transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 70px -20px rgba(20,19,15,.42);border-color:#d2ccc0}.ds-shot{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#efece6;border-bottom:1px solid #e2ddd4}.ds-body{padding:20px 22px 21px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}.ds-body h3{margin:0;font:400 25px/1.14 'Instrument Serif',Georgia,serif;letter-spacing:-.012em;color:#14130f}.ds-body p{margin:0;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:#514c44}.ds-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.ds-tags span{padding:4.5px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:11.5px;font-weight:500;background:#efece6;color:#514c44;border:1px solid #e2ddd4}.ds-tags .ds-more{background:transparent;border-style:dashed;color:#8b8479}.ds-cat{padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid #e2ddd4;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8b8479}.ds-cat i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#e0533d}.ds-cat b{font-weight:600;color:#514c44}

narrative.overview: A calm room with warm paper walls and a serif voice. The library is a place to read about design languages, not to be dazzled by one, so the interface is a quiet frame: off-white paper, one near-black ink, hairline rules, and Instrument Serif for every title. Reference screenshots supply all of the colour; the chrome around them stays neutral so no entry competes with another.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white ground with a single near-black ink; no brand accent in the chrome.
Serif titles over a neutral sans body, with small uppercase tracked labels for metadata.
Pill-shaped controls (buttons, chips, tags, search) and 14px to 18px rounded surfaces.
Hairline borders plus one soft shadow recipe; depth is modest and only grows on hover.
Light and dark are both first-class; dark is a warm near-black, not blue-black.

rules.name: The Content Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays neutral; hue comes only from screenshots, palette swatches and the small category dots.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: There is a single dark ink for text, selected states and primary actions. A second accent colour is not introduced for emphasis.

rules.name: The Serif Names Rule
rules.body: Serif is for names and the page title only. Descriptions, controls and metadata stay in the sans.

rules.name: The Hover-Lift Rule
rules.body: Elevation changes only in response to pointer state; at rest the page is nearly flat.

dos: Do keep chrome neutral and let screenshots and swatches provide colour.
Do use Instrument Serif only for the page title and style names.
Do define every colour as a CSS variable in `:root`, and redefine it for `prefers-color-scheme: dark` and `[data-theme="dark"]`.
Do keep light and dark both fully designed.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for entrance and hover motion.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent colour for emphasis; selection is expressed by inverting to ink.
Don't use a template SaaS look: gradient heroes, feature-card rows, stock marketing patterns. This is a confirmed visual anti-reference.
Don't treat the current look as the target of the redesign; it is recorded as the incumbent baseline.
Don't load anything external except Google Fonts, and don't add a build step or dependency (see PRODUCT.md).
